meta.name: firecrawl-scrape
meta.description: Extract clean markdown from any URL, including JavaScript-rendered SPAs. Use this skill whenever the user provides a URL and wants its content, says "scrape", "grab", "fetch", "pull", "get the page", "extract from this URL", or "read this webpage". Handles JS-rendered pages, multiple concurrent URLs, and returns LLM-optimized markdown. Use this instead of WebFetch for any webpage content extraction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任意网址提取干净Markdown内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从网页获取结构化文本用于LLM或文档处理。
copy.tagline_en: Extract clean markdown from any URL
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to get structured text from web pages for LLM or document processing.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你给的网址，提取网页的干净 Markdown 内容，包括 JavaScript 渲染的页面。支持同时处理多个网址，并返回适合 AI 阅读的格式。
howto.when: 当你提供网址并想要其内容，或说出“抓取”、“提取”等关键词时触发。也适用于需要获取网页正文的场景。

say.text: 帮我抓取这个网页的内容：https://example.com
say.note: Claude 会提取该网址的 Markdown 内容。

say.text: 抓取 https://example.com 并只保留主要内容

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can extract clean markdown from any URL you provide, including JavaScript-rendered SPAs. It supports multiple concurrent URLs and returns LLM-optimized markdown.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a URL and want its content, or say "scrape", "grab", "fetch", etc. Also used for extracting webpage content.

say_en.note: Claude will extract markdown from the URL.
Claude will scrape multiple URLs concurrently.

say_en.text: Scrape https://example.com with only main content
